title: Spruce Health SE field scratchpad
content:
Quick notes (working):

Customer: Spruce Health - private VPC deployment in us-east-1
Primary contact: Lina Park (IT), solution sponsor: Mark D.

Today objectives:
- finish KMS handshake steps
- validate dedicated routing policy for patient-data-model
- run perf pass with 8k seq, measure p95 and TPU fallback

Action items:
1) KMS/HSM
- add service account redwood-spruce-kms with role glue:encrypt,decrypt (temp role draft)
- pending: Lina to confirm key rotation policy and HSM requirement
- sample CLI (placeholder): aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/spruce-prod --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-spruce-kms

2) Batching / runtime knobs
- start with batch_target_tokens=1024, max_batch_latency_ms=50
- enable prefix kv-cache for repeat queries (important for patient lookup patterns)
- model pinned to llama-2-v7-seq8-q4_0 (quantized) for cost tradeoff

3) Routing / capacity
- dedicated pool: min_replicas=3, max_replicas=15, burst_to_shared=true (fallback path)
- ensure taints on dedicated nodes: node-role=dedicated-spruce:NoSchedule

Observed issues during initial test run:
- p95 latency spiked to ~1.2s on long sequences (8k) when cache miss occurred
- selected log excerpt: [2024-11-07T16:09:12Z] serve: batch flush size=1, reason=timeout, latency=1.18s
- autoscaler behavior: scaled down to 1 replica overnight, need to raise min_replicas

Hypotheses:
- autoscaler min_replicas too low for cold KV cache; bump to 3
- quantized variant occasionally triggers slower kernels for long context (verify kernel selection)

Open questions / blockers:
- Do they require HSM-backed CMKs for PHI? Lina to confirm (email sent).
- Network egress policy: is there a proxy that rewrites TLS SNI? Could affect private control plane connectivity.
- Acceptable SLA for rolling upgrades? Need to confirm maintenance window.

Next tests / checklist:
- [ ] run 30m load test: 20 rps mix (70% short, 30% long) -> capture p50/p95/p99 token cost
- [ ] run same test with model variant q4_1 (if available) and compare token cost + p95
- [ ] validate KMS grant after Lina confirms rotation/HSM
- [ ] open infra PR for node taints + dedicated nodepool labels (link to PR after creation)
- [ ] schedule follow-up call with Spruce IT (propose Tue 11/12 10:00 PT)

Snippets / local commands (notes):
- validate tenant route: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/spruce/health
- start perf job (local helper): rdperf run --target 30rps --duration 1800 --model llama-2-v7-seq8-q4_0 --seq 8000
- check autoscaler events: kubectl -n redwood get hpa spruce-dedicated -o yaml | yq .status

Links referenced:
- GH PR for k8s nodepool changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/283
- Jira item: SE-872 - Spruce private deploy checklist
- Confluence: SE/Spruce Health Onboarding (network diagram + compliance notes)

Personal notes / heuristics:
- during calls, capture exact error messages and paste into GH issue instead of paraphrasing
- keep config diffs small; prefer incremental canary rollout for model changes
- if p95 > 800ms on long seqs, escalate to runtime team for kernel inspection

Quick log of today's call (16:00):
- Lina: confirmed they want rotation frequency quarterly but still checking HSM requirement
- Mark: wants cost estimate for q4_0 vs q4_1 by EOD Wednesday
- Action: Priya to produce cost delta spreadsheet and drop in Confluence page

TODO (short):
- [ ] finalize KMS integration and confirm HSM requirement
- [ ] update rollout policy: canary -> 10% for 30m, then 50% over 2h
- [ ] raise min_replicas to 3 in dedicated pool (temporary)
- [ ] draft infra PR for node taints + labels
- [ ] schedule follow-up with Spruce IT

End of scratchpad.
